SPACER · MECHANICAL DESIGN · FINITE ELEMENT ANALYSIS

Fractal End-Effector Design and Analysis

Design and structural evaluation of a compliant fractal structure for robotic end-effector applications.

Project overview

This project explores the design of a fractal end-effector and the use of Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to evaluate its mechanical behaviour.

Engineering activities

  • Development and refinement of the end-effector geometry.
  • Finite Element Analysis to study deformation and stress distribution.
  • Evaluation of the structure's mechanical performance under defined loading conditions.
